It is important that an electric table lamp with a lamp shade does not get knocked over easily.
shade
base
Which statement is correct?
A
The centre of mass must be as low as possible.
B
The lamp must have a shade which is heavier than the base.
C
The lamp must have a narrow base.
D
The lamp shade must be wide.

options.label: A
options.text: The centre of mass must be as low as possible.

options.label: B
options.text: The lamp must have a shade which is heavier than the base.

options.label: C
options.text: The lamp must have a narrow base.

options.label: D
options.text: The lamp shade must be wide.
